import sys
n=int(sys.stdin.readline())
assert 2<=n<=100000
a=bytearray(n+1)
count=0
for i in range(2,n+1):
    if not a[i]:
        count+=1
        for j in range(i*i,n+1,i):
            a[j]=1
print(count)
